LightningComponentBundle.description: AI-powered assistant for meeting summaries and wealth plan structuring.

property.name: flowApiName
property.label: Wealth Plan Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that returns structured JSON.

property.name: meetingSummaryFlowApiName
property.label: Meeting Summary Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that returns meeting summary text/HTML.

property.name: regenerateSummaryFlowApiName
property.label: Regenerate Summary Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow for regenerating meeting summaries. Accepts inputs: currentSummary (String), instructions (String). Returns: generatedResponse (String).

property.name: saveSummaryFlowApiName
property.label: Save Summary Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that saves a MeetingNote__c in the background (no flow navigation). Inputs: noteId (Text), noteHtml (Text), eventId (Text), published (Boolean). Output: savedNoteId (Text).

property.name: versionHistoryFlowApiName
property.label: Version History Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow fired when an event is selected. Input: EventId (Text). Output: MeetingNoteVersions (Collection of MeetingNoteVersion__c). Returns version history for the selected event.

property.name: createVersionFlowApiName
property.label: Create Version Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow fired when saving or publishing a new version of a published note. Creates a MeetingNoteVersion__c record and updates the parent MeetingNote__c. Same inputs as Save Summary Flow. Output: savedNoteId (Text).

property.name: saveTodosFlowApiName
property.label: Save To-dos Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that creates Task records from accepted action items. Inputs: TodosJson (Text), EventId (Text), WhoId (Text). Output: SaveResult (Text, optional).

property.name: saveFileToEventFlowApiName
property.label: Save File to Event Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow invoked when an advisor saves an uploaded file to the event record. Inputs: ContentDocumentId (Text), EventId (Text).

property.name: wealthPlanSaveFlowApiName
property.label: Wealth Plan Save Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched flow that receives typed SObject record collections (GoalsToCreate, AssetsToCreate, etc.) and handles all Wealth Plan DML. When set, save is delegated to this subflow instead of the parent screen flow.

property.name: inputWhoId
property.label: Who ID (Contact / Lead)
property.description: WhoId of the Contact or Lead to link to saved Task records. Pass the Event's WhoId from the parent Flow.

property.name: modalMode
property.label: Open as Modal Overlay
property.description: When enabled, the component shows as a compact launcher card that opens in a full-screen overlay.

property.name: briefEnabled
property.label: Show 'At a Glance' Brief
property.description: When enabled, shows a collapsible 'At a Glance' section above the meeting summary if the flow returns a MeetingBrief output variable.

property.name: briefOpenByDefault
property.label: Brief Open by Default
property.description: When enabled, the 'At a Glance' section starts expanded instead of collapsed.

property.name: inputEvents
property.label: Meeting Events
property.description: Event records to display as selectable meeting context. The component starts loading automatically — no separate loading flag needed.

property.name: inputMeetingNotes
property.label: Meeting Notes
property.description: MeetingNote__c records matched to events via Event.MeetingNote__c lookup (fields: Id, Note__c).

property.name: inputArtifacts
property.label: Meeting Artifacts
property.description: Meeting_Artifact__c records linked to events via Event.MeetingArtifacts__c.

property.name: inputContentDocumentLinks
property.label: Content Document Links
property.description: CDL records for artifact files. Fields needed: ContentDocumentId, LinkedEntityId.

property.name: inputContentDocuments
property.label: Content Documents
property.description: ContentDocument records for display metadata. Fields needed: Id, Title, FileType.

property.name: modalMode
property.label: Open as Modal Overlay

property.name: outputMeetingNote
property.label: Meeting Note (for Update)
property.description: Populated when saving a summary for an event with an existing MeetingNote__c. Contains Id + Note__c (+ Published__c). Use in a flow Update Records element. Mutually exclusive with outputMeetingNoteToCreate.

property.name: outputMeetingNoteToCreate
property.label: New Meeting Note (for Create)
property.description: Populated when saving a summary for an event with NO existing MeetingNote__c. Contains Note__c only (no Id). Use in a flow Create Records element, then update Event.MeetingNote__c using outputSelectedEventId. Mutually exclusive with outputMeetingNote.

property.name: outputSelectedEventId
property.label: Selected Event ID
property.description: Id of the currently selected event. Use after Create Records (outputMeetingNoteToCreate) to update Event.MeetingNote__c with the newly created note Id.

property.name: outputNoteIdToDelete
property.label: Output: Meeting Note Id to Delete
property.description: Deprecated — retained for backwards compatibility with existing flow versions. Deletion is now handled via the Save Summary Flow (deleteNote flag).
